```{.r .cell-code}
set.seed(123)
ratings_orig <- tibble(
  ID = 1:120,
  Friends = c(rnorm(40, 8.5, 0.5), rep(NA, 80)),
  ModernFamily = c(rep(NA, 40), rnorm(40, 7.5, 0.6), rep(NA, 40)),
  BigBangTheory = c(rep(NA, 80), rnorm(40, 6.5, 0.7)),
  Gender = rep(c(rep("Male", 20), rep("Female", 20)), 3) # 20 males + 20 females for each show
)
```
:::


# Convert from wide to long format


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ratings_long <- ratings_orig %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Friends, ModernFamily, BigBangTheory), names_to = "Show", values_to = "Rating") %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(
    Show = factor(Show, levels = c("Friends", "ModernFamily", "BigBangTheory")),
    Gender = factor(Gender, levels = c("Male", "Female"))
  )
ratings_long
```

```{.r .cell-code}
library(latex2exp)  # For TeX label
library(ggformula)
library(paletteer)

# Assuming you have 
# ratings_long with Show (Friends, ModernFamily, BigBangTheory)
# Rating as numeric response
# Gender factor (Male, Female) optionally for color

# Fit ANOVA model with Show as factor
ratings_anova <- aov(Rating ~ Show, data = ratings_long)

# Visualize the fitted ANOVA model predictions over jitter of actual data
ratings_long %>%
  mutate(fitted = fitted(ratings_anova)) %>%
  gf_jitter(Rating ~ Show,
    width = 0.2, alpha = 0.6,
    color = ~Show,
    data = .
  ) %>%
  gf_summary(
    group = ~1,   # connects all points with a line
    fun = "mean", geom = "line", colour = "lightblue",
    lty = 1, linewidth = 2
  ) %>%
  gf_point(fitted ~ Show,
    color = ~Show,
    shape = 2,
    size = 6
  ) %>%
  gf_segment(fitted + fitted ~ 0 + Show, linetype = 2, color = ~Show) %>%
  gf_annotate("label",
    label = TeX(r"($Rating = \mu_{Friends} + \Delta_{ModernFamily} + \Delta_{BigBangTheory} + e$)", output = "character"),
    parse = TRUE,
    y = max(ratings_long$Rating) - 0.5,
    x = 2.25,
    size = 3, color = "black", fill = "lightblue"
  ) %>%
  gf_annotate("label",
    label = "Triangles are Predictions\n at each Show level", y = min(ratings_long$Rating) + 0.5, x = 1.25,
    size = 3, color = "black", fill = "moccasin"
  ) %>%
  gf_labs(
    title = "Fitted ANOVA Model Equation",
    x = "TV Show", y = "Rating"
  ) %>%
  gf_refine(
    scale_colour_paletteer_d("ggthemes::colorblind"),
    guides(colour = guide_legend(title = "Show"))
  )
```
